data.title: Binance Adds  BCC/USDT, BCC/ETH and BCC/BNB Trading Pairs
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

 

BCC/USDT, BCC/ETH and BCC/BNB trading pairs are now available on Binance.

Details:

  1. About Bitcoin Cash (BCC)
  2. Fees
  3. Rules

Risk warning: cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Thanks for your support and happy trading!

Binance Team

2017/11/11

 

Find us on

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange

Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance_2017
